summary: This directory serves as the centralized testing suite for the file update and merge planning logic, providing verification of the transformation process from input documentation to output file states.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of generated file update plans
Validate the correctness of merge strategy execution
Test the rendering logic for JsDoc documentation
Ensure integration between documentation updates and file modifications
relationships: Test suites ensure that file update plans correctly interpret documentation changes before being applied.
The merge planning tests verify that multiple documentation sources are correctly combined into a coherent file update.
Rendering tests confirm that processed documentation is formatted according to specification prior to file integration.
designDecisions: Use of shared testing utilities for environment setup and file comparison
Categorization of tests into unit-level logic checks and integration scenarios
Isolation of filesystem-dependent operations using temporary directories
